metadata.dataset_name: Future policy and market scenarios for the biopharmaceutical waste-routing MILP
metadata.purpose: Test focused policy, market and technology changes against the current central-carbon-value optimum while retaining a separate private-cost reference for constraint definitions.
metadata.application_rule: Use BASE_CURRENT_POLICY as the reporting and percentage-change baseline. Apply one scenario family at a time. Carbon-cap and residual-waste-cap cases are solved as minimum-private-cost constrained policy cases; other families retain the central lifecycle carbon value unless explicitly stated.
metadata.price_year_rule: Convert real 2020 and real 2025 carbon values to the optimisation model's common price year before adding them to nominal operating costs.
metadata.comparison_rule: All reported deltas are calculated against BASE_CURRENT_POLICY, not against the private-cost constraint reference.

base_case.description: Constraint reference only: private-cost optimisation with grid electricity forced, no lifecycle carbon value and current 2026 waste-policy parameters. It is not the reporting comparison baseline.

lifecycle_carbon_value.description: Internalises the societal value of decision-dependent life-cycle GHG emissions in the objective.
lifecycle_carbon_value.goal: Test whether routing, water reuse, transport or electricity decisions change when climate damages are valued alongside cash cost.

source.name: DESNZ, Valuation of greenhouse gas emissions for policy appraisal and evaluation

CARBON_VALUE_NONE.description: Private-cost optimisation with no lifecycle carbon value.

carbon_cap.description: Constrains annual net life-cycle GWP relative to the unconstrained BASE_2026 solution.
carbon_cap.goal: Compare explicit emissions-cap policy with the central carbon-value optimum, without applying both policy instruments simultaneously.

model_application.optimisation_objective: minimum annual private network cost subject to the GWP cap (lifecycle carbon value set to zero for this family)

source.name: Science Based Targets initiative, 2026 Absolute Contraction Approach update
Science Based Targets initiative, explanation of the 4.2% annual 1.5C contraction rate
source.note: Applied only as a model-boundary proxy, not as an SBTi-validated corporate target.

CARBON_CAP_PARIS_PROXY_2030.description: Single-period 2030 snapshot using 4.2% linear annual contraction from a 2026 baseline.

CARBON_CAP_PARIS_PROXY_2035.description: Single-period 2035 snapshot using 4.2% linear annual contraction from a 2026 baseline.

CARBON_CAP_STRINGENT_50.description: Stress test requiring a 50% reduction from BASE_2026 GWP.

landfill_tax.description: Varies the standard-rate Landfill Tax applied to pharmaceutical SUT plastics while retaining the underlying landfill gate fee.
landfill_tax.goal: Test how stronger disposal taxation shifts material from landfill toward EfW or recycling.

model_application.formula: total_landfill_cost = loaded_current_landfill_cost - current_tax + scenario_tax; this preserves the model's converted gate-fee component

source.name: HMRC, Landfill Tax rates from 1 April 2026

LANDFILL_TAX_NONE.description: Counterfactual with no Landfill Tax; the underlying WRAP gate-fee component is retained and converted to nominal 2026 GBP.

LANDFILL_TAX_CURRENT.description: Current standard-rate tax from April 2026, added to the converted underlying gate-fee component.

LANDFILL_TAX_HIGH.description: Future-policy stress test at twice the current standard-rate tax, added to the converted underlying gate-fee component.

efw_uk_ets.description: Adds the cost of UK ETS allowances to gross fossil CO2 emitted by plastic Energy-from-Waste treatment.
efw_uk_ets.goal: Test the planned 2028 expansion of the UK ETS and its potential to make recycling more competitive than EfW.

model_application.boundary_rule: Use gross fossil stack CO2, not net EfW LCA GWP after energy credits.

source.name: UK ETS Authority, scope expansion to waste
DESNZ, Traded carbon values used for modelling purposes 2025

EFW_ETS_NONE.description: Current MRV-only reference with no allowance cost passed through.

EFW_ETS_2028_CENTRAL.description: Central 2028 allowance-cost scenario with full marginal cost pass-through.

EFW_ETS_2035_CENTRAL.description: Longer-term central 2035 allowance-cost scenario with full marginal cost pass-through.

residual_waste_policy.description: Caps combined landfill and EfW mass relative to BASE_2026 residual disposal.
residual_waste_policy.goal: Compare an explicit residual-disposal constraint with the central carbon-value optimum, without stacking the central carbon value onto the cap.

model_application.optimisation_objective: minimum annual private network cost subject to the residual-disposal cap (lifecycle carbon value set to zero for this family)

source.name: Defra, Residual waste reduction Environment Act target delivery plan

RESIDUAL_WASTE_CAP_2030_PROXY.description: Site-level proxy for the approximately 24% national residual-waste reduction expected by 2030.

RESIDUAL_WASTE_CAP_2042_PROXY.description: Site-level proxy for the approximately 50% national residual-waste reduction target by 2042.

recyclate_market.description: Varies the market value received for saleable recycled LDPE, LLDPE and PP output.
recyclate_market.goal: Test whether weak or strong recyclate markets materially alter the cost-optimal routing decision.

source.name: OPIS, EU recycled plastic market reporting
source.note: The multipliers are transparent sensitivities around the sourced June 2026 prices, reflecting observed market volatility rather than forecasts.

RECYCLATE_PRICE_LOW.description: Weak-demand market with polyolefin recyclate prices 25% below the current values.

RECYCLATE_PRICE_CURRENT.description: Current sourced recyclate output values from MILP_params.json.

RECYCLATE_PRICE_HIGH.description: Tight-supply or strong-demand market with polyolefin recyclate prices 25% above current values.

local_mains_water_availability.description: Constrains the mains water that a local water-resource zone can reliably supply to an industrial site.
local_mains_water_availability.goal: Test whether local water scarcity or drought restrictions drive water reuse, production relocation or lower site utilisation.

source.name: Environment Agency, water resources planning guideline
Environment Agency, National Framework for Water Resources

MAINS_WATER_NORMAL.description: All sites can purchase their full BASE_2026 mains-water requirement.

MAINS_WATER_OXFORD_CONSTRAINED.description: Oxford faces a 25% local mains-water supply reduction; other sites remain unconstrained.

MAINS_WATER_CAMBRIDGE_CONSTRAINED.description: Cambridge faces a 25% local mains-water supply reduction; other sites remain unconstrained.

MAINS_WATER_SLOUGH_CONSTRAINED.description: Slough faces a 25% local mains-water supply reduction; other sites remain unconstrained.

MAINS_WATER_SEVERE_REGIONAL.description: Severe regional stress with only 50% of BASE_2026 mains-water availability at all sites.

industrial_electricity_conditions.description: Varies source-specific delivered electricity costs while preserving the loaded grid and wind LCIA factors. No electricity scenario silently changes plastic-route LCIA factors.
industrial_electricity_conditions.goal: Test grid-price exposure, conditional BICS bill support and an illustrative renewable cPPA premium without assuming that a cPPA is automatically cheaper than conventional supply.

model_application.cost_formula: Apply each scenario cost rule only to the listed electricity source(s); retain all other loaded source costs.
model_application.gwp_rule: Retain the loaded grid and wind LCIA factors. A price scenario does not change GWP unless it changes the optimiser-selected electricity mix.
model_application.availability_rule: Do not force grid or wind selection. The optimiser remains free to choose any source available in the loaded model.
model_application.autoclave_rule: Keep autoclave route cost and LCIA coefficients on their validated central basis; electricity-market scenarios do not rewrite embedded plastic route factors.
model_application.relevance_rule: A scenario may change cost without changing GWP or decisions. If the central optimum already selects wind, a grid-only price shock may correctly have no effect.

source.name: UK Government, British Industrial Competitiveness Scheme
UK Government, Corporate Power Purchase Agreements

ELECTRICITY_LOADED_BASELINE.description: Loaded source-specific electricity prices from MILP_params.json; no override.

ELECTRICITY_PRICE_SHOCK.description: Grid-only high-price stress case based on the observed Q3 2022 manufacturing price plus the 2026/27 levy. The wind/cPPA price remains at its loaded value.

ELECTRICITY_BICS_2027_CENTRAL.description: Conditional BICS case using the midpoint £37.5/MWh reduction. The model assumes the eligible bill reduction passes through to both conventional grid supply and sleeved renewable supply; eligibility and site-level qualifying shares remain conditional.
ELECTRICITY_BICS_2027_CENTRAL.eligibility: conditional_on_final_scheme_rules, eligible SIC/HS products, electricity-intensity test and site qualifying share

ELECTRICITY_RENEWABLE_CPPA.description: Illustrative sleeved renewable cPPA priced at a 5% premium to the loaded conventional grid price. This tests contract cost uncertainty and does not assume that renewable procurement is cheaper. Grid and wind remain available to the optimiser.
ELECTRICITY_RENEWABLE_CPPA.availability: conditional_on_contract, creditworthiness, volume, term and project supply

CHEMICAL_RECYCLING_STRAP_HYPOTHETICAL.paper_scenario: Scenario 2: one PE-selective solvent wash with saleable PE and EVOH outputs

selection_coupling.rule: LLDPE and EVOH originating from the same eligible multilayer-film stream must use the same route-selection decision
selection_coupling.note: The optimiser retains the actual LLDPE and EVOH masses already present in the inventory.

shared_processing_cost.recommended_basis: Gross paper OPEX excluding the feedstock purchase transfer, because the integrated optimisation already owns the waste and separately receives the recyclate-value credit.

facility_context.model_treatment: Do not charge the TCI unless the optimisation explicitly includes construction of a dedicated STRAP plant. For the hypothetical route, treat it as an external shared facility.

source.paper:
Recycling of Single-Use Multilayer Plastics for Biomanufacturing
with Solvent-Targeted Recovery and Precipitation

transport.basis: Explicit hypothetical one-way distances to a representative shared Midlands facility, retained from the prior thesis scenario code. No facility or measured route is asserted; treat as a scenario assumption.

reporting_baseline.description: Current model optimum using loaded 2026 parameters and the central lifecycle carbon value. All scenario deltas are reported against this case.
